name: index_youtube_playlist
description: Queue a public YouTube playlist for lyric indexing in Lirify. Returns a job id and, when wait is true, the final job status. Handles invalid URLs, auth failures, rate limits and private/deleted playlists with a machine-readable error code.

playlist_url.description: Public YouTube playlist URL (youtube.com/playlist?list=..., music.youtube.com/playlist?list=..., youtube.com/watch?v=...&list=...) or a bare playlist id.

source_bot.description: Name of the agent submitting the playlist; stored on the job for audit.

limit.description: Index at most N videos from the playlist. Omit for the whole playlist.

wait.description: Poll until the job commits or fails. Set false for fire-and-forget.
